status: authored 2026-09-30; overrides only, no coordinates, nothing placed in a world
consumed_by: tools/route_trainers.py, which emits the overrides into build/datapacks/cobblers_trainers
finding_this_fixes: F11 in docs/FLIGHT_FINDINGS_2026-09-29.md: our eight authored gym leader teams reached no player. grep -rl gym_01_brock over build/, modpack/ and server/ returned nothing on 2026-09-29. tools/route_trainers.py was the only tool writing data/rctmod/trainers/* and it wrote Routes 1-3 only; data/progression.json's upstream_neutralised emptied each leader's loot table at the upstream id but never replaced the roster behind it. So a player fought Cobbleverse's own kanto_brock and won our badge and our first-win rewards.
why_overrides_and_not_new_ids: The spawner names the id and cannot be re-pointed without breaking the badge. data/gym_buildings/gym1.json places rctmod:trainer_spawner{TrainerIds:["kanto_brock"]} and records the verified consequence: 'a persistent kanto_brock anywhere awards the badge (verified on staging 2026-09-24)'. data/progression.json binds gym1_cleared to kanto_brock, the first-win reward table is keyed by kanto_brock, and Cobbleverse's own gym template carries a spawner locked to the same id. Overriding the upstream id's team at the upstream path (.claude/rules/datapacks.md) is therefore the only change that puts our roster in front of a player while leaving every badge, flag and reward where it already points. It is the same mechanism as data/league_trainers.json, for the same reason.
not_emitted: Deliberately not written for these eight: the dialogue file (story is Codex's; these leaders' dlg_* ids resolve nowhere in data/dialogue.json and no text is invented here, so upstream's lines stand until Codex writes ours), the rctmod mob file (the spawner owns how each is spawned, and a spawnWeightFactor 0 override could break it), the loot table (already emptied by data/progression.json upstream_neutralised, which pays the badge and the TM through first_win_rewards instead), an advancement (each gymN_cleared flag already fires from the upstream id through tools/progression_pack.py), and any entry in placements(): these stand where their spawner puts them, so there is nothing for tools/reapply.py to summon.
contract: generation_contract.gym_ace_levels is [20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55]. All seven emittable leaders' top level equals their contract level exactly (checked 2026-09-30, and re-checked by tools/route_trainers.py on every run, which fails closed on a disagreement rather than adjusting one). Giovanni's 55 has no team to check.
